[Ph.D. student in Applied Mathematics, School of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences, Arizona State University]{.home-lead}

I am currently interested in multimodal and interpretable machine learning. One of my favorite things is when mathematics makes the world a little less mysterious. I am also passionate about supporting the success of students who are underrepresented in the mathematical sciences, like myself.

More on the [research overview](research.qmd), or see [publications and presentations](publications.qmd).
